title: ICT Project Management: Supplementary Exam, August 2020
programme: Bachelor of Business Information Technology / bachelor of Information Technology
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: List the five main characteristics of a project.
Briefly explain the four phases of a typical project management life cycle.
Discuss the factors that contribute to project success and failure.
List the steps involved in designing a questionnaire.
Explain three basic tools of quality that help in performing ICT project quality control.
Critically evaluate how the Program Evaluation and Review Technique (PERT) can be used for project time management.
Explain how project risk transfer can benefit an organization.
Briefly discuss the phases of software development.
Scope management in an ICT project impacts on the quality of the project product. Identify and briefly explain the scope management aspects that affect project quality in an ICT project.

items.text: For a project to be successful, the project manager has to deal effectively with any problems that might arise during the life cycle of a project.

parts.text: Identify five common problems that a project manager might have to resolve and explain the impact that each of these problems would have on the project if not managed effectively.
Explain the inputs to the procurement planning of ICT project management.
Explain expert judgment as an estimation method and give its limitation.

As an undergraduate student, you intend to come up with a research proposal as one of the graduation requirements. You propose to develop a new web search algorithm, then implement it using Java, and finally conduct some experimental validation of the algorithm in the lab using 80 of your 160 fourth year students as subjects. The experiment simply compares whether the new algorithm is more efficient than the Google web search algorithm. Develop a rough but reasonable budget estimate for this project.
A schedule is also required for the same project in (b) above. Develop a realistic schedule for this project.
Assuming you use the waterfall model for programming of the software project in (c) above, what are some of the deliverables you expect to get at each milestone?
